name: infinite_lives
description: The unmodified game, except the player never loses energy and never dies.
evidence: $2B88 is the single action every collision path funnels through, and the damage routine has two lifted entry points: $2B88 sets up and falls through, while $2B8F is a separate entry, so both have to be covered
$2B8F decrements the energy count at $3B, and $2B93 loads 1 into the death flag at $62 when that decrement reaches zero
replacing the decrement with LDA #$01 leaves the Z flag clear so the guarding BNE always skips the death store, and $2630 begins TYA/PHA/LDA $3B so clobbering A is safe
loading 0 rather than 1 before the death store makes it harmless even if a caller enters below the decrement
qualifications: two NOPs cannot replace the decrement: NOP sets no flags, so the guarding BNE would read whatever the preceding subroutine return left behind and could set the death flag on the first contact
damage still plays its sound and redraws the bar, so contact stays visible and audible; only the cost is removed
$2732 also writes the death flag, inside the control poller and reached by a key nothing has ever pressed, so it is left alone
everything else is the original game: the starting room, enemies, lifts, collisions and the pause keys are all unchanged
